data_description.region: Shark IQ uses different services in the EU. Select your region to connect to the correct service for your account.

user.description: Sign in to your SharkClean account to control your devices.

abort.no_devices: No vacuums are currently loaded for this account. Reload the integration and try again.

init.title: Cleaning presets
init.description: A preset bundles a set of rooms, a clean mode, and a fan speed into a one-tap button on the vacuum's device card.

add_preset.title: Pick a vacuum
add_preset.description: Which vacuum should this preset target?

preset_form.title: Preset details
preset_form.description: Name, rooms, clean mode, and fan speed for this preset. The button entity name follows the preset name.

remove_preset.title: Remove preset(s)
remove_preset.description: Pick one or more presets to delete. The corresponding button entities will disappear after the integration reloads.

invalid_room.message: The room {room} is unavailable to your vacuum. Make sure all rooms match the SharkClean app, including capitalization.

invalid_fan_speed.message: Fan speed {fan_speed} is not supported. Use one of: Eco, Normal, Max.

clean_room.description: Cleans a specific user-defined room or set of rooms.

rooms.description: List of rooms to clean. Pre-populated from your device's room map; pick one or more.
rooms.name: Rooms

clean_type.description: Cleaning mode (newer hybrid devices only). 'dry' vacuums, 'wet' uses the mop pad, 'matrix' is a denser pattern, 'spot' focuses on a small area.
clean_type.name: Clean type

fan_speed.description: Suction power applied before the clean starts. Eco, Normal, or Max.
fan_speed.name: Fan speed

clean_room.name: Clean room
